resolvedFindings: Single-worker empty/recovered job needs completion after admission
Shared cursor can starve a short OCR document when synchronous work is ready
Lane cursors must also survive periods when synchronous work is in flight

fullSuite.environment: Pinned production dependency image, read-only source checkout, local development identity setting; no external network

limitations: Scheduler verification does not prove OCR recognition accuracy.
Deadlines are not guaranteed during overload or stuck inference.
No production rollout is claimed by this review.

actualModelBurst.scope: Local patched scheduler experiment on production base image, 2CPU/3GiB, burst of 20 OCR jobs plus concurrent tables/orientation on 3-page synthetic scan; fixed in-memory download, no network/cloud/data writes; not accuracy/staging/capacity acceptance
actualModelBurst.interpretation: Interactive readers complete instead of timing out. Total burst time increased and now includes successful table/orientation work; this is not a claim of improved bulk OCR throughput.
